🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: PR re-tracks the gitignored project-memory path `memory/` (scope violation)**

This PR adds two new tracked files, `memory/note/n_1030_8dda.md` and
`memory/note/n_1030_a0cf.md` — raw `memory_add` agent-session artifacts
(`accessCount`/`importance` frontmatter, `[[agent]]` wiki-links) — under
the `memory/` path the repo deliberately closed to git in gh-2185:

```gitignore
# .gitignore:229-236
# gh-2185: memory/ left git too — the project
# memory store consolidated into .fah/memory (local-only, covered by the
# .fah/* rules above); the root copy is ignored so the old path can never
# re-track notes.
/memory/
```

Verified on this branch:

- `git ls-tree origin/main -- memory/` → empty (nothing under `memory/` is
  tracked on main; the merge-base is the gh-2185 hygiene commit itself).
- Both files are tracked **only** on `ai/gh-2194`, i.e. force-added through
  an ignore rule whose stated purpose is "the old path can never re-track
  notes".
- `git check-ignore memory/note/<new>.md` → matches `.gitignore:236:/memory/`.
- AGENTS.md (Memory footnote): project scope is `.fah/memory/note/` since
  gh-2185 — **local-only, not committed**.
- The PR description says "site markup + one new test only" — the notes are
  unacknowledged scope (the WIP-auto-save sweep class the .gitignore
  comment right above warns about).

This is exactly the two-homes divergence gh-2185 just eliminated (tracked
logs/generated dumps purged, "memory store consolidated to ONE home"); the
ticket's fix is landing-page markup + guard test, so these files are scope
creep beyond it.

**Fix**: untrack both files without deleting them locally:

```bash
git rm --cached memory/note/n_1030_8dda.md memory/note/n_1030_a0cf.md
```

If either note has lasting value, it belongs in `.fah/memory` (local, via
`memory_add`) or, as durable documentation, under `docs/` — not in a
tracked `memory/` directory.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGGESTION: the guard's regex is not the "same extraction contract" as the CI probe it mirrors**

The doc comment (lines 32-34) claims *"Same extraction contract as
scripts/assert_release_assets.sh --landing"*, but the regex differs from
the script's extractor on two axes. The script (assert_release_assets.sh,
`--landing` mode) uses:

```bash
url_class="[^\"' <>()+,$(printf '\t')]"
urls=$(grep -oE "https?://${url_class}+" "$page" | grep -E '/releases/(latest/)?download/' ...)
```

i.e. scheme `https?://` and a class that stops at **both** quote types
(`"` and `'`). This test matches `https://` only and stops at `"` only —
so a future landing-page edit that introduces an `http://…releases/latest/download/…`
link or a single-quoted URL would pass this offline guard and still red
the tag-train probe hours later — precisely the rot class (gh-2194) the
guard exists to catch offline.

Verified against the current page both extractors agree (only
`…/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`, which is in the required
set), so this is latent — but the parity claim should be exact, or the
narrowing documented. Suggested fix (keeps the parity true):

```dart
final deepLinks = RegExp(
  "https?://[^\"' <>()+,\\t]*/releases/latest/download/[^\"' <>()+,\\t]+",
).allMatches(index).map((m) => m.group(0)!).toSet();
```

(or keep `https://` and drop the "same extraction contract" sentence,
stating the deliberate narrowing instead — same for the script's
`tr -d '[:space:]'` vs the test's `.trim()`, equivalent under the
one-name-per-line required-set contract).

comments.body:
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The gh-2194 landing fix itself is correct and the new offline guard provably pins the CI contract (verified RED→GREEN against the pre-fix page; `dart analyze` clean), but the PR also re-tracks two agent-memory note files under the `memory/` path gh-2185 deliberately gitignored ("the old path can never re-track notes").

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `memory/note/n_1030_8dda.md` + `memory/note/n_1030_a0cf.md` — tracked on this branch only, matched by `.gitignore:236`; scope violation of the gh-2185 one-home memory invariant (see inline thread).
- 💡 `test/site/landing_deep_links_test.dart:35` — the regex diverges from the `assert_release_assets.sh --landing` extractor it claims to mirror (`https` only vs `https?`; `"` only vs `"`+`'`) — latent offline-guard hole.

**Digest**:
- `site/index.html:474` — the version-pinned `v1.0.636` APK deep links stay outside the offline guard by design (test docstring: frozen history); only the live tag-train probe covers them — acceptable, noted for awareness.

**Next Steps**:
1. Untrack the memory notes (`git rm --cached memory/note/n_1030_*.md`); local memory lives in `.fah/memory` per gh-2185.
2. Align the guard regex with the probe (`https?://`, exclude `'`) or narrow the "same extraction contract" comment.
